description: Pinned public sources of the Paper 3 final reference panel (retrieved 2026-10-20). Files are downloaded by `residue-screen fetch-sources` and verified by SHA-256; no source content is stored in this repository.

sources.name: ONT_chemistry.html
sources.purpose: ONT Chemistry Technical Document (CHTD_500_v1_revAV_24July2026): native barcode table with forward/reverse columns, native and Rapid flank statements, barcode tables
sources.redistribution: Oxford Nanopore Technologies document; not redistributed here

sources.name: dorado_barcode_kits_v2.1.2.cpp
sources.purpose: Dorado v2.1.2 barcode_kits.cpp: barcode sequences, kit flanks and the SQK-RBK114-96 / SQK-NBD114-96 barcode lists
sources.redistribution: Dorado source file under its repository licence; not redistributed here

sources.name: porechop_adapters_109e437.py
sources.purpose: Porechop adapters.py at commit 109e437: legacy ONT adapter and primer definitions (secondary source)
sources.redistribution: GPL-3.0 per file header; not redistributed here

sources.name: Illumina_UD.html

sources.name: Illumina_Nextera.html

sources.purpose: PacBio shared protocol on barcodes: 16-nt barcodes and the 16+45+16 barcoded adapter (reference only)
